blueprint.name: AWS EKS Existing Cluster
blueprint.description: Adopt an existing AWS EKS cluster and emit BNK registration outputs. This is the first step of the existing-cluster blueprint chain; additional modules (cert-manager, BNK prerequisites, FLO, CNEInstance, License) will be added in subsequent revisions.

outcomes: An existing AWS EKS cluster is referenced by name
Cluster outputs are available for BNK managed-cluster registration
A kubeconfig with a short-lived STS token is emitted for downstream modules

prerequisites.description: The modules/eks-cluster-register deployment pack from this repository must already be synced into Forge.

prerequisites.name: aws_access_key_id
prerequisites.description: Provide an AWS credential template or project secret that can supply the AWS access key ID and secret access key.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: Provide AWS credentials, region, and the name of the existing EKS cluster you want to adopt.

required.name: aws_region
required.description: AWS region where the existing EKS cluster resides.

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the existing AWS EKS cluster to adopt.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token (only required for STS-assumed-role credentials).

modules.name: EKS Cluster Register
modules.description: Reference an existing EKS cluster and emit BNK registration outputs.
